text_block_list.text:
Through 'how to order coolly' and 'cool 
instruments,' Vodka and I have been 
searching for what it means to be cool, 
butâ

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"What 'coolness' really is, huh... I've 
been thinking about that for a long time, 
too."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I get that it looks cool on the surface, 
but it's like there's something way beyond 
just that...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I still can't put it into words 
properly! It's so frustrating!

—Just then, angry shouts could be heard 
coming from a nearby storefront.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Hm? It's pretty noisy outside the shop.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
"I told ya! How many times do I gotta say 
it?! Get me your manager, not you!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...What, just another complainer? How 
lame..."

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: What was that!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What, so you heard that?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's the truth, ain't it? What 
you're doing is super lame.”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The hell, it ain't like I said anything 
wrong.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: Tch...!

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you over there! If you're this brat's 
guardian, teach 'em some manners!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hah!? Why the heck are you apologizing?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's a straight-up fact that this guy's 
attitude is absolute trash and lame as 
hell!

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
How dare you talk down to me like you're 
some big shot, you little brat?!

"At this rate, it's going to turn into 
trouble. What should I do—"
choice_data_list: Vodka, I leave it to you.

text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, it's going to turn into 
trouble. What should I do—"
choice_data_list: Vodka, I leave it to you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: Oh? You gonna take me on?

I can't let Vodka get injured. Just as I 
took a step forward, intending to handle 
things calmly—
(Slip...)

text_block_list.name: Vodka & Man A
text_block_list.text: Ah!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer?! Wait, are you for real...?!

Vodka's panicked voice gradually faded 
into the distance, and then—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh, finally awake, are you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Don't go doing things that are out 
of character for ya.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Can't you tell just by looking? It's the 
academy's infirmary."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's no big deal. Well, y'know, it's 
just...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You collapsed, so I just carried you all 
the way back to the Academy on my back. 
That's all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Man, tripping right when you're trying to 
take a cool step forward... You really are 
hopeless.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Felt weird calling an ambulance over 
something like that, so I just carried 
them in myself.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess that was kind of what I 
wanted to do...

After saying that much, Vodka fell silent 
for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, remember? I asked you what being 
'cool' really means, didn't I?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...I can't really put into words yet what 
makes something look cool, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about looking cool on the 
outside, you know—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"When something happens, your body just 
moves on its own. Now that's what being 
truly cool is all about."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: In other words—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm saying the moment you stepped up to 
protect me was the absolute coolest you've 
ever looked!!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Geez! I'm only saying this once, got it?!
With just that, Vodka looked away from me—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you—

Grabbing Vodka by the arm, I sprinted away 
from the spot as fast as I could.

After running non-stop for quite a while, 
I was finally able to catch my breath in a 
deserted park.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, we didn't do anything wrong, so 
why'd we run away?”
choice_data_list: Sorry for making you look bad!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Really, Vodka is so clueless when it 
comes to other people's feelings."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Scarlet...? What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I was actually there earlier, too. 
...Though everything was already over 
before I could say a word.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hah!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, that doesn't matter. Anyway, what 
I'm trying to say is—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's obvious Trainer ran away just to 
protect you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What'll you do if you act reckless and get 
hurt? Are you okay with not being able to 
run anymore?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Protect... me? Is that true?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about pushing forward 
recklessly. When it's for someone else's 
sake, you have to know when to swallow 
your pride and step back.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So there's that kind of cool, too...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Well, knowing me, I might still end up 
doing crazy things from now on, but—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Will you stop me then too, just like 
today, I wonder...?
choice_data_list: Of course, that's what I intend to do.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haa... Stop acting like a spoiled brat. 
Vodka, you need to grow up a little too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm not being needy! Don't say weird 
crap like that!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm a full-fledged adult already! 
Right...?!"

I could only offer a bitter smile in 
response to Vodka's question.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh... What does that—
choice_data_list: You already know what's right, don't you?
You already know what's right, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
What's the deal, are we doing this or 
not!?
And what Vodka chose was—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... Good grief. My right arm's 
crying out, itching for a real brawl.

—After that, Vodka calmed the situation 
down by reasoning, "I'm calling the 
police."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still though, you sure had the guts to say 
"Leave it to me" in a spot like that.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"What if I totally went berserk and we 
beat the crap out of each other? What 
then?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "...You believed in me? In *me*?"

I told her that I had faith in her 
self-control. When I said that—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Hah. It's probably... your influence.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The old me probably would've picked a 
fight without thinking about the 
consequences.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still, it reminded me of how Trainer 
apologized right at the start.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I just... lost the will to fight, you 
know? ...Man, how things have changed.
choice_data_list: I think that kind of thing is cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Me... cool...? What are you 
talking about?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Spouting nonsense out of nowhere—
choice_data_list:
Being able to hold yourself back when it 
counts is cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Not just picking fights, but—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: There's that kind of cool, too... huh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I've come to understand 
what it truly means to be "cool"—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I realized something else, too. Um... I 
just figured I should at least say 
thanks."

With those words, Vodka scratched her head 
to hide her embarrassment.
